title: Beta Fences
description: A recreation of the Beta Fences Icon
body:
# Beta Fences!!!!
Do you want to have the bugged icon that fences used to have in Beta? Well this is the pack for you!

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![A Screenshot of a GUI with a 5x3 grid of fences](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/L7MeErsQ/images/e6554088cde7c3845fa80eb1735b4dd2e177c509.png)

</details>



With this Resource Pack you will be able to see what stairs used to look like in beta but in Vanilla Modern Minecraft!
Mod Support will be added in the future alongside other add-ons! If you have any suggestions please dm me on discord: miffenkop (Or put it in the issue tracker)
